maddeler.e:
نحتقب (form VIII)
# نَحْتَقِبُ (naḥtaqibu) /naħ.ta.qi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# نُحْتَقَبُ (nuḥtaqabu) /nuħ.ta.qa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# نَحْتَقِبَ (naḥtaqiba) /naħ.ta.qi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# نُحْتَقَبَ (nuḥtaqaba) /nuħ.ta.qa.ba/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
